package com.freerangepets;

/**
 * Simulation fidelity tier for a roaming pet relative to the player.
 */
enum PetTier
{
	/** Inside the loaded scene on the same plane: rendered and stepped tile by tile. */
	SCENE,
	/** Close to the loaded scene: stepped tile by tile without rendering. */
	NEAR,
	/** Far from the player: simulated along time-interpolated {@link Itinerary} legs. */
	FAR
}
